description: nix eval .#homeConfigurations.shirka.config.programs.vscode.enable (also ash-devbox) fails with: error: The option `sops' does not exist (while evaluating config.home-manager.users.yann). Pre-existing: reproduces at e05299be, before epic nix-ltz. The nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.home-manager.users.yann path evaluates fine, so standalone home-manager on NixOS hosts is broken while the integrated one works. Darwin standalone (homeConfigurations.ash) unaffected.
title: Standalone NixOS homeConfigurations fail to evaluate (sops option missing)
